One_line_rationale: OpenAI closed a $122B round at an $852B valuation in March; Anthropic raised ~$65B at ~$965B in spring. Both labs made early-June confidential IPO filings; no public sign of financial distress.
A July 30 third-party tracker put OpenAI annualized revenue near $43B. Anthropic's last public run-rate was still ~$47B (May); no July funding or solvency stress.
Polymarket bankruptcy markets opened Sep 17, pricing each lab's bankruptcy odds in the mid-teens to ~17%. Reports on heavy 2026–2028 compute burn sharpened scrutiny of both labs' cash needs.
Bloomberg: OpenAI in talks with UAE funds (incl. MGX) and BlackRock to anchor a $30B+ round at ~$1.4T pre-money; IPO pushed to 2027. Anthropic reported to be preparing an IPO as soon as November.

OpenAI told investors 2026 revenue would be ~$50B, well below the ~$70B run-rate signaled weeks earlier (Guardian, Oct 9). The $30B OpenAI raise and Anthropic's expected November IPO both remained on track.

Anthropic told investors Q3 revenue rose 45% to $16.8B and that it was profitable on an adjusted basis (Reuters, Oct 14); it plans to file publicly on Oct 26 for a mid-November IPO (IFR). OpenAI's ~$30B raise at ~$1.4T was still in talks with no term sheet; PitchBook put fair value near $1T as losses keep growing.

Anthropic made its S-1 public on Oct 26 (Nasdaq: ANT): H1 2026 revenue of $16.3B, up ~14x, with an implied ~85% gross margin, ~900% net revenue retention and just $6.2B of debt; most of its $80.7B H1 net loss was a non-cash convertible-note revaluation (CNBC). The filing also showed ~$266B of noncancelable compute purchase commitments plus ~$321B of lease obligations, and flagged possible material revenue losses from its Pentagon dispute; the IPO could top SpaceX's record $86B raise and would beat OpenAI to market (AP).

OpenAI cut its new round to ~$20B from ~$30B at a $1.25T post-money valuation as some investors trimmed allocations, with the first close expected below $20B (FT, CNBC, Oct 31). A tech selloff left the Nasdaq 7.8% below its Oct 6 high, while Anthropic's IPO stayed on track: a Nov 2 filing showed up to $3.5B of shares to be sold to Japanese investors, with ~$1.5T valuations discussed (Reuters).

OpenAI closed ~$11B, the first tranche of a round now capped near $20B at a $1.25T valuation, with Coatue, T. Rowe Price, SoftBank and an MGX-led UAE syndicate in (Bloomberg, Nov 6). Anthropic is pressing ahead with a pre-Thanksgiving IPO targeting $80B-$100B at $1.25T-$1.75T, down from ~$2T hopes after a tech selloff and a Democratic midterm sweep stoked data-center backlash; its amended S-1 showed Q3 revenue up ~50% to ~$17B and an ~$81B run rate (FT, CNBC, Reuters).
